messages:
Sam: Quick sync 3: planning a tenant-vpc split tonight. Canary in staging at 21:15 UTC, main at 22:00 UTC. Need deploybot pin and a short quiet window (22:00-22:30).
Aisha: Ack. I'll draft a short release note and add runbook link. Which TF modules change?
Sam: network/vpc, network/route53, iam/service-accounts. No DB changes.
Marco: Any risky IAM rotations?
Sam: We create tenant-bouncer SA and add a restricted cross-account monitoring role. No wide rotation.
Priya: Prepare an ephemeral-cred fallback (use existing monitoring role) in case SA provisioning fails.
Sam: Plan: canary apply 21:15 staging (dry-run posted), main apply 22:00. If SA creation fails, abort and rollback network change only, open incident.
Aisha: I'll add release-note text: "tenant-vpc split 3 canary -> main; tenant-bouncer SA; ephemeral-iam fallback prepared".
deploybot: Request created id=rb-20240328-78, dry-run done. Preflight checks 8/8 passed. Link: https://deploys.example.com/rb-20240328-78
Sam: deploybot, pin window 22:00-22:30, suppress auto-merge, set deploybot-override=false.
deploybot: Pin confirmed. Auto-merge suppressed.
Marco: Paste plan summary here once dry-run is up. Any destroy ops?
deploybot: Dry-run summary: +3 resources, 2 IAM binding updates, no destroys. Plan: https://plans.example.com/rb-20240328-78/plan.txt
Sam: Snippet:
```
# network/vpc: + aws_vpc.tenant_vpc
# iam/service-accounts: + google_service_account.tenant_bouncer
# iam/bindings: ~ google_project_iam_binding.monitoring (1 attr change)
```
Priya: Rollback template: 1) terraform apply -target=module.network -var='rollback=true' 2) revert route53 if DNS issues 3) escalate security. OpsDuty, create ticket template.
OpsDutyBot: Ticket TKT-4485 created with runbook https://confluence.example.com/display/INF/tenant-vpc+rollback
Marco: If IAM binding update retries exceed 120s, abort IAM changes and run IAM-only rollback. We had propagation issues last month.
Sam: Adding preflight iam-verify.sh (2 retries, 30s apart). If verification fails, flag manual rollback.
Priya: Ensure telemetry hooks (per-route token latency + failed SA create rate) active.
deploybot: Hooks registered: iam-verify.sh, telemetry-hook. Canary schedule locked.
Aisha: I'll push release note draft to #release-notes and tag security.
Sam: Attaching commit sha f3c2a9a and changelog line "tenant-vpc split + tenant-bouncer SA" to deploy metadata. Will post runbook reminder 30m before main. :thumbsup:
